act_sections.section_title: Direction for grant of bail to person apprehending arrest
act_sections.context: State Of Gujarat, [LAWS(GJH)-2019-7-69] [Referred To] Referred Act(s) : - Code Of Criminal Procedure, 1973, S.438 Headnote: A.
The Appellants shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 438(2) of the Criminal Procedure Code.

headnote_raw: A. On the facts and circumstances of this case, the condition imposed by the High Court while granting anticipatory bail that the first Appellant should deposit Rs. 10 lakhs and the second Appellant should deposit Rs. 5 lakhs before getting the benefit of anticipatory bail, in our opinion, is onerous. Hence, in modification of the said order while affirming the grant of anticipatory bail, we direct the Appellants to furnish a self-bond of Rs. 50,000 each and one surety for the like sum each to the satisfaction of the Court or the arresting authority as the case may be. C. The Appellants shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 438(2) of the Criminal Procedure Code.

numbered_paragraphs.text: Heard learned Counsel for the parties.

On the facts and circumstances of this case, the condition imposed by the High Court while
granting anticipatory bail that the first Appellant should deposit Rs. 10 lakhs and the second Appellant
should deposit Rs. 5 lakhs before getting the benefit of anticipatory bail, in our opinion, is onerous.
Hence, in modification of the said order while affirming the grant of anticipatory bail, we direct the
Appellants to furnish a self-bond of Rs. 50,000 each and one surety for the like sum each to the
satisfaction of the Court or the arresting authority as the case may be.

The Appellants shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 438(2) of the Criminal
Procedure Code.
